items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I used to play in this fusion band called Free Flight. A flute player named Jimmy Walker and Mike Garson the piano player, and Alex Acuna played drums.

ctx.x: I started on electric bass. And I started to play the acoustic bass when I was eleven when I started going to junior high school. So ever since then I still pretty much do a juggling act. You know the gigs that I’ve had in the last few years never called for electric bass so I just never had a chance to play it in public. So a lot of people forgot that I still play electric bass because I used to play with a band, everyone always kids me about this, actually I only did a few gigs with them, but I used to play in…
Well with your father playing rhythm & blues, and you being a James Brown fan, how was it that you got an interest in “Stars Fell on Alabama” for instance?
